name: net_worth_dent
label: The dent in his net worth
description: Real net worth each year next to what he'd have if every mishap so far came out of it, 2000-2024 (every year, so the line runs through the years between seasons).

metrics.name: net_worth_mid
metrics.label: LD's Net Worth
metrics.description: Larry David's net worth that year: the central (mid) estimate from reported figures (see the sources page), with the real 2007 divorce added back. Single-year only.

metrics.name: cumulative_mishap_loss
metrics.label: Cumulative Financial Loss
metrics.description: Running total of every kept mishap from the first episode up to and including each period, in each year's own dollars.

metrics.name: net_worth_after_mishaps_to_date
metrics.label: Net Worth After Mishaps
metrics.description: That year's real net worth minus every mishap up to and including that year: what he'd have if the character's losses were real. Query it grouped by metric_time__year.
